svg.metadata: {"attribution":"Technology Commons teaching materials by Andrew Andrade and contributors","category":"jigs-gauges","description":"A vertical seven-hole template on 32 mm pitch with a 37 mm edge setback reference.","dimensional_tests":{"edge_setback_mm":37,"pitch_mm":32},"dimensions":{"height":240,"width":70},"editors":["Inkscape","Vectorpea"],"files":{"preview":"generated/previews/jigs-gauges/tc-jig-shelf-spacing.svg","svg":"generated/svg/jigs-gauges/tc-jig-shelf-spacing.svg"},"fit_type":"none","generator":{"name":"technology-commons-laser-generator","version":"0.1.0"},"id":"tc-jig-shelf-spacing","kerf_assumptions":{"clearance_mm":0.15,"kerf_mm":0.15,"warning":"Starting values only; select from a physical calibration cut."},"license":"CC-BY-SA-4.0","material":{"measured_thickness_mm":6.0,"name":"Baltic birch plywood","nominal":"1/4 inch","warning":"Measure every sheet; nominal 1/4 inch plywood is not necessarily 6.35 mm."},"notes":"Clamp to a verified cabinet edge and use an appropriate drill guide; the laser-cut part is a layout template, not a precision bushing.","operations":["CUT","SCORE","ENGRAVE"],"parameters":{"edge_setback_mm":37,"hole_count":7,"hole_diameter_mm":5,"pitch_mm":32},"review_status":"unverified","sensitivity":"none","shop":"general","skill_level":"introductory","source_reference":"Original procedural geometry; no traced or copied commercial artwork.","subcategory":"shelf-spacing","tags":["gauge","jig","shelf","shelf-spacing","spacing"],"title":"32 mm shelf-hole spacing template","tool_family":"shelf-spacing","trademark_status":"original-generic","units":"mm"}
